issue.title: taskId collides for two tasks that start with the same words
issue.body:
`taskId` in src/ids.js returns `slug(text)`, and `slug` truncates at 48 characters on a word boundary. Two different tasks whose opening words match therefore get the same id, and anything keyed on it silently overwrites.

`node --test test/ids.test.js` fails on "distinguishes two long tasks that start with the same words".

Expected: `taskId` is stable for the same input and distinct for different inputs, while staying readable — appending a short digest of the full text is the usual fix. `slug` itself should keep its current behaviour, because other callers rely on it being a plain slug.

provenance.note: hand-authored; mirrors the real slug() collision recorded in this project's own open items
